info.title: Deliverables inventory (fake demo API)
info.description: Returns the per-asset deliverable inventory the distribution-readiness agent uses to compute the `have` field. Fake data; demo only.

servers.description: Lambda Function URL — replace with the terraform output `fakeapi_deliverables_url` at registration time.

get.summary: List the deliverables an asset currently has in inventory.
get.description: Pass the asset_id from the knowledge store. Returns a `have` list the agent subtracts from the per-territory `requirements` to compute `missing`.

have.description: Deliverable labels present in inventory (video, poster, subs:de, trailer, …).

get.summary: Aggregate counts across the whole inventory.
get.description: 'N of M assets have a trailer' / 'K of M have German subs'. Useful for territory-level narrative in the distribution_card summary.

200.description: Rolled-up counts across every known asset.
